note: On starting point he is the ICP almost exactly: sub-20% body fat, a 200 kg deadlift, a decade of lifting and Thai boxing, and a stated goal of 10% body fat and better function — good going to great, with no rescue required. He is the opposite of deconditioned. But three criteria fail. Occupation was never asked, so 'already successful' is entirely unevidenced. Income fails on behaviour, not assumption — he could not commit to £730 a month, cited a partner's veto and chose a £147/month product. And health is not his neglected area at all; he trains hard, eats well and sleeps unexamined only because nobody asked. The stated ICP describes someone whose health lags their success, and here the health is ahead of everything we know.
